draft_en.subject: One question — Marvell Industrial Alert System
draft_en.body:
Hi Daniel,

We have sent you a few mails on "Marvell Industrial Alert System" and you never had a reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

Alongside the Maiwe industrial switches you carry with your industrial PCs, we supply DIN-rail 5-GE, 8-GE + 2 SFP and 8-PoE + 2 SFP units (−40~75 °C, CE/RoHS; managed versions on a Marvell platform) neutral-brand from single units, EXW USD — which industrial switch SKU do your automation customers order most?

Reference price: DIN-rail 8-GE + 2 SFP unmanaged industrial switch (STI-280GE) $46 USD EXW, MOQ 1 pc, 15-day validity, 3-year warranty.

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
